method: Employer primary-source description, combined with current GitHub inventory and existing open PR metadata; subjective fit not hiring probability
scope: 19 selectively relevant published postings; not all vacancies
source_quality: Official hiring domain (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Mistral, Microsoft AI, Scale AI, Vals AI)

roles.title: Finance Expert Lead, Gemini Data
roles.minimum: Master's or equivalent and experience evaluating LLM/generative AI performance for finance.
roles.key_requirements: Finance workflow taxonomy; gold data and detailed grading rubrics; data quality, coverage, vendor SME coordination; model failure reproduction; Python/evaluation research.
roles.gap: No independently adjudicated real multi-model finance evaluation or documented team-scale expert curation.
roles.next: Complete an authorized, blind finance-LLM benchmark, finance-rubric handbook, error taxonomy, reproducible model comparisons, and SME calibration.
roles.hard_gate: Valid role location, hands-on LLM measurement

roles.title: Applied AI Architect, Education
roles.minimum: Significant customer-facing technical architecture experience and software/cloud foundations; can engage institutional executives and engineers.
roles.key_requirements: Universities and educational change management; APIs/SDKs, Python/JS, security and identity, retrieval/model eval, enterprise rollout and measurable adoption.
roles.fit: Priority 2 — exceptional education-domain fit, technical deployment gap
roles.gap: No independently verified university production rollout, SSO-integrated deployment, institutional KPI baseline or technical customer portfolio.
roles.next: Build a privacy-preserving, working university sandbox with mock SSO, citations, role-based access, logs, load test, cost/latency and adoption plan.
roles.hard_gate: Enterprise technical ownership and demonstrable production adoption

roles.title: Evaluation Engineer, Applied AI
roles.minimum: PhD OR 2+ years industry experience; strong Python; experience building with LLMs; shared reviewed codebases; can work with domain specialists.
roles.key_requirements: Design expert workflows into scored benchmarks; real-tool agent evaluations; clean data and synthetic proxies; multi-model comparison, regression control, presentation.
roles.fit: Priority 3 — high scholarly-method fit, engineering proof needed
roles.gap: No independently executed real multi-model headroom benchmark in a shared externally reviewed codebase or real-software agent evaluator.
roles.next: Create audited Finance/Audit Evals-50 with external human gold, baseline vs GPT/Claude/Gemini/Mistral, adversarial cases, independent PR and research note.
roles.hard_gate: Strong Python and actual LLM systems experience

roles.title: Research Program Manager, Frontier Assurance
roles.minimum: Demonstrated cross-team research program management, independent assessments, third-party research partnerships and AI evaluations literacy.
roles.key_requirements: External safety evaluator independence, adversarial testing, robust reporting and transparency, program delivery, ability to interpret uncertainty and limitations.
roles.gap: No independently completed frontier safety assessment, evaluator contract/partner evidence, or external signed assurance outcome.
roles.next: Demonstrate reviewer charter, conflict checks, independent blind gold, quantitative disagreements, system-card-style transparent reporting.
roles.hard_gate: US office eligibility/relocation; safety research partnerships

roles.title: GRC Program Manager, Audit & Controls
roles.minimum: Direct ownership of audit/assurance outcomes; practical control design, evidence, remediation and technical cloud/system fluency.
roles.key_requirements: Common control framework risk→owner→environment→evidence; Codex automation, SQL/APIs, cloud identity and logging, scope drift, measurable audit efficiency.
roles.fit: Priority 5 — domain strong; cloud security execution less evidenced
roles.gap: No documented cloud identity/control operating-effectiveness audit on live organization infrastructure, nor measurable pre/post workflow savings.
roles.next: Build a permissioned sample IDP/SaaS control system with evidence snapshots, tamper and owner-change tests, SQL audit trail and signed remediation pack.
roles.hard_gate: Deep operating audit ownership and real cloud technical fluency

roles.title: International Finance Program Management
roles.minimum: 10+ years program/project/PMO roles; >=3 years finance/accounting; experience managing entity set-ups or multi-country rollouts.
roles.key_requirements: Accounting, tax, treasury, payroll, finance systems, legal cross-functional governance; escalation; entity inventory; project tooling; reporting.
roles.fit: Priority 6 — finance leadership relevant; program tenure/expansion evidence unknown
roles.gap: Specific 10-year PMO leadership and hands-on multi-country entity establishment cannot be verified from GitHub.
roles.next: Prepare redacted proof of delivered multinational rollout, RACI/critical path/risks, executive dashboard and firm-specific migration lessons.
roles.hard_gate: 10+ PM experience and multi-country entity setup

roles.title: Applied AI Architect, Industries
roles.minimum: Enterprise customer-facing technical advisory with hands-on LLM solution architecture and successful integration.
roles.key_requirements: Technical discovery, trust, integration, architectural tradeoffs, safety, enterprise demos, production deployment.
roles.fit: Priority 7 — regulated-sector knowledge strong; deployment evidence thin
roles.gap: Lacks independently verified customer production deployment and engineering integration artifacts.
roles.next: Create provider-neutral reference architecture, mock client system APIs and documented production readiness tests.

roles.title: Finance Subject Matter Expert, AI Models, Evaluations and Data
roles.minimum: Master's; 5 years institutional finance (quant trading / corporate finance / alternative assets), LLM eval pipelines and diagnosis of wrong model finance outputs.
roles.key_requirements: Atomic deterministic rubrics, GAAP vs non-GAAP ambiguity, multi-step agent traces, gold finance examples, Python/SQL, SEC/market data.
roles.fit: Priority 8 — domain alignment; US location and specialized institutional finance screen
roles.gap: No validated public agent-trajectory dataset with errors and repair traces; sector-specific 5 years must be evidenced in CV.
roles.next: Publish permitted finance QA errors and audit/corporate finance golden traces with expert rubric and regression tests.
roles.hard_gate: Institutional finance years and true LLM diagnostics

roles.title: Research Program Manager, Governance
roles.minimum: Track record delivering ambiguous cross-functional research/technology/governance work and synthesizing conflicting evidence.
roles.key_requirements: Evidence-based governance reviews, practical recommendations, executive communication, safety/research/legal/product stakeholder coordination.
roles.fit: Priority 9 — research/governance fit; sector-specific experience to document
roles.gap: No independent real-world decision record from frontier-AI governance or third-party expert signoffs.
roles.next: Publish sanitized governance decision records, falsification and escalation templates tied to public frontier-safety examples.

roles.title: Data Science, Finance & Strategy
roles.minimum: Senior finance analytics/business intelligence; SQL/Python/dbt/warehouse and executive metric operations.
roles.key_requirements: Weekly usage/revenue metrics, governed definitions, executive dashboards, dimensional modeling, grain/SCD/point-in-time integrity, Claude-driven recurring reporting.
roles.fit: Priority 10 — finance analytics strong; production analytics stack needs evidence
roles.gap: No real usage-based cloud/API business metrics pipeline with dbt, warehouse, semantic metrics, weekly operations and dashboard.
roles.next: Develop 12-period synthetic/authorized revenue-token-cost star schema, SQL/dbt tests and versioned executive analytics dashboard.
roles.hard_gate: Operational analytics platform and executive metrics ownership

roles.title: Business Operations, Senior Program Manager
roles.minimum: Bachelor's plus 5+ years business/program ops; 3+ years enterprise collaboration administration; 3+ years workflow/AI automation.
roles.key_requirements: Teams/Slack/Linear admin, workflow design, integrations, tooling operations, executive support, automation outcomes.
roles.github: NAAIL OpenLab; selected workflow automation demos
roles.fit: Priority 11 — operational leadership partially relevant; platform-specific experience not verified
roles.gap: No 3-year evidence of administering enterprise collaboration tooling and no measured enterprise workflow migration.
roles.next: Demonstrate Teams/Slack/Jira integration only through authorized sandboxes and quantify cycle time, reliability and admin effort.

roles.title: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer
roles.minimum: Applied/forward-deployed ML engineering with customers and technically complex production systems.
roles.key_requirements: Customer discovery, custom model/agent integration, deployed robust AI systems, lifecycle, ML and software delivery.
roles.gap: No proven enterprise customer AI deployment, SLA, latency/cost or incident record.
roles.next: Complete permissioned demo service with observability, security, API contract, cost budgets and deployment evidence.

roles.title: Audit Operations Lead
roles.minimum: Big Four SOX404 or ICFR audit engagement experience; several years hands-on SOX scoping, control testing, GRC system operations.
roles.key_requirements: Auditor requests/PBC, audit calendar, COSO, PCAOB standards, control matrices, deficiency evaluation, automation and reporting.
roles.fit: Low unless mandatory industry audit requirements are independently met
roles.gap: GitHub cannot substitute specifically required Big Four SOX404 engagement and GRC implementation experience.
roles.next: Do not imply Big Four experience; submit only if independently documented or obtain clarification about equivalent experience.
roles.hard_gate: Explicit prior Big Four SOX/ICFR experience

roles.title: Research Engineer, Post-Training Model Evaluations
roles.minimum: Strong Python with evaluation of ML systems at scale and debugging production post-training results.
roles.key_requirements: Live eval fleet, reliable model-quality signal, real-time regressions, dashboards, model release decisions, technical statistical rigor.
roles.github: Saeid-Homayoun-Test PR #16; financial sentiment NLP reference
roles.gap: No demonstrated large-scale inference/post-training eval production systems or model intervention record.
roles.next: Independent benchmark pipeline with drift/regression charts, alert latency, model version tracking, and reproducible tests.

roles.title: Research Engineer — Eval Platform
roles.minimum: Master's/PhD computer science or equivalent; 4+ years production software, Python, CI/CD and distributed GPU workloads.
roles.key_requirements: GPU cluster evals, benchmark comparability over versions, dashboards, agent/tool evaluation, vLLM/Slurm/Kubernetes familiarity.
roles.gap: No public GPU-cluster eval platform, CI across distributed inference, vLLM or Slurm demonstrated.
roles.next: Not a near-term priority unless building real ML systems engineering track record.
roles.hard_gate: Production software and GPU cluster experience

roles.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
roles.minimum: 7+ years engineering with multi-year production AI/ML system ownership.
roles.key_requirements: Regulated AI deployment, ML evaluation/MLOps at scale, fine-tuning/inference tradeoffs, technical client leadership and product delivery.
roles.fit: Stretch — staff-level production engineering not verified
roles.gap: No demonstrated 7 years software engineering or multi-year production AI system delivery.
roles.next: Build and document genuinely used production AI system before treating as a priority.

roles.title: Evaluations Engineer
roles.minimum: Professional Python; shipped engineering; Git/PR collaboration; current LLM benchmarking expertise.
roles.key_requirements: Benchmark maintenance, model adapters, failure analysis, model release cadence, open source contributions.
roles.fit: Potential after genuine model benchmark proof
roles.gap: No real-model release comparison, external contribution acceptance or production infrastructure evidence.
roles.next: One independently reviewed eval contribution with real scored predictions and public artifact, then compare employer requirements.
roles.hard_gate: Strong Python engineering and shipped systems

roles.title: Applied AI Engineer, Health
roles.minimum: Engineering experience developing production LLM applications, evaluation pipelines and healthcare-safe outputs.
roles.key_requirements: LLM product evaluations, datasets, stakeholder communication and production deployment in health.
roles.github: NAAIL OpenLab; IFRS-AI-Inspector; user healthcare finance experience not verified by GitHub
roles.fit: Stretch — healthcare domain familiarity but not clinical/product engineering
roles.gap: No demonstrated production healthcare LLM application or clinically reviewed safety evaluation.
roles.next: Only pursue after an ethically reviewed, nonclinical healthcare-finance benchmark and product architecture.
roles.hard_gate: Production LLM engineering and healthcare-domain safety

roles.title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise
roles.minimum: Munich role requires native/fluent German; 6+ years SWE/solutions architecture/FDE and enterprise pre-sales.
roles.key_requirements: LLM production deployment, technical advisory, C-level workshops, compliance, evaluation and German-speaking enterprise stakeholders.
roles.fit: Low unless language and engineering tenure satisfied
roles.gap: No verified fluent German or 6 years enterprise AI solutions engineering; GitHub cannot resolve spoken-language eligibility.
roles.next: Prioritize language-appropriate markets instead of assuming skills compensate for mandatory fluency.
